title: Reinforcement Learning under State and Outcome Uncertainty: A Foundational Distributional Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2609.24103v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In many real-world planning tasks, agents must tackle uncertainty about the environment's state and variability in the outcomes of any chosen policy. We address both forms of uncertainty as a first step toward safer algorithms in partially observable settings. Specifically, we extend Distributional Reinforcement Learning (DistRL)-which models the entire return distribution for fully observable domains-to Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs), allowing an agent to learn the distribution of returns for each conditional plan. Concretely, we introduce new distributional Bellman operators for partial observability and prove their convergence under the supremum p-Wasserstein metric. We also propose a finite representation of these return distributions via psi-vectors, generalizing the classical alpha-vectors in POMDP solvers. translated_title: 状态与结果不确定性下的强化学习：一种基础性的分布式视角
translated_abstract: 在许多现实世界的规划任务中，智能体必须应对关于环境状态的不确定性以及任何所选策略结果的变异性。我们同时处理这两种形式的不确定性，作为在部分可观测环境中迈向更安全算法的第一步。具体而言，我们将分布式强化学习——该方法为完全可观测领域建模完整的回报分布——扩展到部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs），使智能体能够学习每个条件规划的回报分布。具体来说，我们为部分可观测性引入了新的分布式Bellman算子，并证明了它们在supremum p-Wasserstein度量下的收敛性。我们还提出通过psi-向量对这些回报分布进行有限表示，从而推广了POMDP求解器中经典的alpha-向量。在此基础上，我们开发了分布式基于点的值迭代算法（DPBVI），该算法整合了psi
tldr: 该论文首次将分布式强化学习扩展到部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs），提出了具有收敛性保证的分布式Bellman算子、推广经典alpha-向量的psi-向量表示，以及分布式基于点的值迭代算法（DPBVI），从而同时应对状态不确定性和结果变异性。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Distributional Reinforcement Learning to POMDPs for the first time, introducing distributional Bellman operators with convergence guarantees, a psi-vector representation generalizing classical alpha-vectors, and the Distributional Point-Based Value Iteration (DPBVI) algorithm to jointly address both state and outcome uncertainty.
